# Farishta

> Farishta is a family dhikr app: a shared dhikr (tasbih) counter that lets a family count dhikr together, live, from every phone.

- Website: https://farishta.si/
- App: https://dhikr.farishta.si/

## How it works
1. Create a room: enter your name, name the room and set a goal (default 12,000).
2. Choose a dhikr from the built-in list, or add a custom one. Each shows Arabic, transliteration and meaning.
3. Share the room code. Family join with their name and the code.
4. Everyone taps +. Every tap adds to one shared count that syncs live on every phone.

## Features
- Live shared count across phones, anywhere in the world
- Group and personal counts, with a per-person list
- Goals with progress
- Rooms keep their count when you leave and return
- Undo a tap with the − button
- Runs in the browser; no download or account
